cpu_policy.digit_full: all worker threads on logical CPU2

formal_extent: Each fresh worker: 20 warmup + 3x100 timed batches; batch1024, original frozen roots, model, Adam and seed0.
interpretation: System comparison includes different CPU scheduling. Not an isolated sampler gain or a comparison with both systems equally CPU-bound. Setup and warmup separate; preserve every run/window and negative results.
reused_smoke_gate: Revalidate both accepted original native smokes from affinity_pair v1 before formal training. No reused formal times.

telemetry.cpu_frequency: sysfs scaling_cur_freq for CPUs observed in worker threads plus CPU2 and SMT sibling
telemetry.gpu_frequency: persistent read-only NVML: graphics/SM/memory clocks, P-state, throttle reasons, power/temperature
telemetry.monitor_cpu: minimum available CPU outside CPU2 and its SMT sibling
telemetry.schedstats_policy: Read only; disabled runqueue stats reported unavailable. No sysctl/governor/global affinity changes.
telemetry.query_failures: retain raw errors and coverage gaps; diagnostic completeness reported separately from native training acceptance
telemetry.window_alignment: perf_counter start and existing elapsed wall time; markers written after original timing/counter collection
